recipes.name: Creamy Macaroni Salad
ingredients_raw: 3 tablespoons finely chopped green bell pepper
3 tablespoons finely chopped red bell pepper
2 tablespoons finely chopped yellow bell pepper

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, 8 minutes.
While the macaroni is cooking, mix salt, dry mustard, garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, white pepper, and black pepper together in a small bowl.
Whisk mayonnaise, evaporated milk, and sour cream together in a large salad bowl until smooth and creamy. Stir in seasoning mix until well blended.
Drain and rinse macaroni under cold water until cooled. Drain again.
Add macaroni, onion, celery, carrots, and bell peppers to the salad bowl; mix until well combined and coated with dressing.

raw_recipe.headline: Creamy Macaroni Salad
raw_recipe.description: This recipe for creamy pasta salad features tender macaroni pasta tossed in a creamy, seasoned sauce made with mayonnaise, sour cream, and evaporated milk.

review.reviewBody: I made a few changes, by deleting the peppers, doubling the spices and adding 1/8 tsp of BALSAMIC VINEGAR , which threw it over the top! And a little shake of celery seed! This is a great! recipe! Yum! And like every good cook, it improved with age! Make it a day or two ahead of time and it's a winner!

This is the mild creamy recipe I have been looking for. (Like the one I find at Sobey's.). The only change I made was using miracle whip instead of mayonnaise. I really enjoyed the subtle flavours and the crunch of the veggies which I diced into small pieces. I stirred everything together and left it overnight in the fridge and found the consistency perfect the next day - it stayed like that for three days in the fridge! Thank you so very much for this

In honor of Father’s Day I made this for my husband because it was something his dad would make during the summer as a treat twice a year. He always added peas. So that was the only addition, and the only omission was celery- they don’t like texture of celery - so I added celery powder instead. It was delicious. Thank you for sharing this recipe.
Always make a day ahead to give the flavors time to be absorbed and meld together. Add black olives, it works, as do green olives. Halved grape tomatoes?
Excluded celery and carrots added shredded cheese and diced ham.

I love cooking but sometimes cannot taste seasonings so, I have the other half handle that. She tasted it and said "It's fine as it is..." and filled a plate. That never happens🤣 I stayed true to the recipe with the seasonings ( ran out of paprika) but used jar pimentos instead peppers, creme fraiche instead of evap milk because I didnt have the ingredients. Left out the carrots. Added 3 boiled eggs Be sure to have paprika. Not sweet. Use Miracle Whip for that. I'm going to use the dressing for a potato salad next time with sweet relish and celery seed. I love it! Thanks! It will taste even better tomorrow.

Allrecipes sent me this recipe through a push email. I have always loved my Mom's Macaroni Salad, but she has yet to give me the recipe, so I decided to give this recipe a try. For those of you looking for a macaroni salad that doesn't have that disgusting store bought tang, this is it. While making it, I was making other recipes for dinner and accidentally added a cup and 1/2 of sour cream. The salad still came out good, just a little more of a sour cream note. My suggestion would be to have all your ingredients ready to go beforehand.
I enjoyed this salad. I didn't have evaporated milk. I had sour cream and milk i used in place with a bit of sugar. Tasty. I used double amount of veggies. Served it at a bbq and it was a hit.
Definitely make it a day ahead so it’s not too runny. Skipped the peppers, used 3 stalks of celery and a whole carrot, probably could have squeezed in a few more veggies
A party for your taste buds! To make it a meal, add some diced chicken or ham, crusty French bread and wait for the moans of delight!

My niece made this and I liked it. Fortunately, she left out the green peppers. But what I found intriguing about it was that, while I didn't like the sauce as much as other mac salads I've had, the overall flavor was much more complex than is typical and I ended up really liking it, much to my surprise. ⭐⭐⭐⭐
I really like the combination of the mayonnaise sour cream and evaporated milk. I always like a creamy macaroni salad, not dry and this was awesome.!
Great easy recipe didn't make any changes I did add some sausage
The extra creamy dressing is exactly what I had been missing for years! Spot on!

I added some sweet peas. I had to do another 2 cups of pasta due to the sauce being runny. I used shell pasta instead of elbow so that might be the reason the sauce was a little runny. I also added a dash of sugar. Hubby doesn't like mustard so I left that out. We're having it with dinner tonight but I know the next day it will really be better, like leftovers usually are.

As expected after viewing the list of ingredients, and following the directions, my macaroni salad turned out to be bland and unappealing. I find it difficult to understand how the recipe recieved such rave reviews. I salvaged the salad with the addition of sugar, vinegar, and a little milk and transformed the recipe into something that was a treat to consume. It defies logic how anyone could enjoy the salad using the original recipe.

Black AND white pepper? More ingredients in this single dish than in an entire Thanksgiving dinner. For that much effort I expected it to be better. Texture was too granular, maybe my bad for dicing veggies into too small of pieces but bigger bits wouldn't change the generally bland taste.
This looks amazing 👏 not sweet like most. Thanks for the recipe
